positions.name: RehearsalAsCapability
positions.frame: what makes a rollback real — is rehearsal constitutive of the capability we claim to have?
positions.why: src-2 asserts that an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback at all — rehearsal is constitutive, not optional. src-1 operationalizes that conviction as a monthly directive. Read together, they ask whether the act of rehearsing is what transforms a rollback procedure into a rollback capability.
